$docs: Production template — commit this, NOT secrets.production.json. Supply values via (1) environment variables (preferred) or (2) mount secrets.production.json on the server (gitignored). Environment variables always override the file.
$envPrefix: Use double underscore for nesting, e.g. Ai__OpenAi__ApiKey=sk-...
$required: Not secrets, but required outside Development and absent from appsettings.json — only appsettings.Development.json carries them. An empty Cors:Origins refuses to boot; an unset Mongo:ConnectionString silently defaults to localhost:27017.

Jwt.SigningKey: <required — min 32 chars; rotate invalidates all sessions>
